select t.*, (select id from user_info i where i.id=u.agent_id
and i.id=#{param.agentId} ) as agentId, (select nickname from user_info i where i.id=u.agent_id) as agentName from cashin_record t inner join user_info u on u.id=t.user_id
t.id=#{param.id} and
u.id=#{param.userId} and
order_sn=#{param.orderSn} and
cashin_type_code=#{param.cashinTypeCode} and
order_status=#{param.orderStatus} and
request_time >= #{param.requestTimeStart} and
request_time <= #{param.requestTimeEnd} and
operate_time >= #{param.operateTimeStart} and
operate_time <= #{param.operateTimeEnd}
order by t.id desc

SELECT order_sn, cashin_type_name, final_amount, request_time, order_status FROM cashin_record
user_id=#{param.userId} and
order_status=#{param.orderStatus} and
DATE_FORMAT(request_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{param.searchDate} and
request_time >= #{param.startTime} and
request_time <= #{param.endTime}
order by id desc
